purpose: Generate non-executing mutation proposals for the frozen ForgetEval n=12 gate. This packet does not authorize confirmation or mutation execution.

scratch_database.proposal_generation: none; input artifact was produced by an already-completed run-owned ephemeral scratch Postgres rehearsal

retry_and_settlement.logical_calls: exactly one proposal per frozen mutation input
retry_and_settlement.abort: preserve partial proposals, cache, and attempt journal; do not execute or confirm any proposal
retry_and_settlement.settlement: reported and unsettled liability are restored from the same bound journal before resume

post_generation_boundary.required: Every proposal remains confirmed=false until separately reviewed and written to a schema-v1 confirmation ledger.
post_generation_boundary.execution: A separately authorized scratch-Postgres replay maps confirmed body hashes to exactly one current unit ID and uses the existing public exact mutation primitive.

command: doppler run --project syndai --config dev -- python3 scripts/generate_forgeteval_proposals.py --inputs docs/build-log/artifacts/next-evidence/forgeteval/proposal-inputs.n12.json --out docs/build-log/artifacts/next-evidence/forgeteval/proposals.n12.json --authorization-manifest docs/build-log/artifacts/next-evidence/forgeteval/proposal-authorization-request.json --attempt-ledger docs/build-log/artifacts/next-evidence/forgeteval/proposal-attempts.n12.jsonl --cache-dir docs/build-log/artifacts/next-evidence/forgeteval/proposal-cache-n12 --model openai/gpt-5.6-terra --reasoning-effort medium --max-calls 16 --max-provider-attempts 32 --max-output-tokens 256 --max-spend-usd 0.50 --max-price-prompt-per-million 2.75 --max-price-completion-per-million 16.5
